hypothesis.label: hypothesis
hypothesis.subcategory: Possibly a freight and fleet operations platform for Indian transport businesses
business_model_candidates: Contracted freight services for business customers
Transport businesses pay for access to a fleet operations portal
A freight marketplace connects businesses needing loads with truck operators
A mix of operations software and freight matching

likely_features.intent: Let customers book freight loads.

likely_features.intent: Adapt assignment of a rider to assigning trucks and drivers to loads.

likely_features.name: Delivery status updates

likely_features.intent: Let drivers upload delivery proof.

likely_features.name: Status tracking

hard_parts: Protecting sensitive customer and driver data with appropriate access controls.
Supporting applicable Indian transport and GST requirements.
Coordinating load, truck, driver, and trip information across multiple branches and teams.
Clarifying whether the product manages one transport business or connects multiple businesses
Making trip updates and delivery proof usable for drivers and dispatchers
Handling finance and compliance needs across branches and teams

provenance.quote: It helps customers book and track freight loads, dispatchers assign our own and hired trucks and drivers, drivers record every trip with proof of delivery, and our fleet, finance and compliance teams keep trucks and drivers legal, maintained and billed correctly.

history.value: A freight and fleet app and portal for customers to book and track loads, staff to manage dispatch and trips, and teams to manage fleet and finance operations.

summary.value: It helps customers book and track freight loads, dispatchers assign our own and hired trucks and drivers, drivers record every trip with proof of delivery, and our fleet, finance and compliance teams keep trucks and drivers legal, maintained and billed correctly.

provenance.quote: Trip updates and delivery proof

subcategory.value: load booking, dispatch, trip tracking, and fleet administration

provenance.quote: Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are all included in the freight charge; nothing is billed separately for the app.

history.value: Customers pay TruckSetu per load, with charges based on distance, weight, and truck type, customer-specific rate cards, and surcharges for waiting time and extra stops. Large customers have monthly contracts. TruckSetu pays hired trucks per trip and settles its own drivers' advances and earnings.
Customers pay no separate app fee; booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are included in the freight charge.

business_model.value: Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are all included in the freight charge; nothing is billed separately for the app.

provenance.quote: Bookings come by phone and WhatsApp, so customers keep calling to ask where their load is, dispatchers lose time matching trucks, and drivers' papers and expenses arrive late.

problem_value.value: Bookings come by phone and WhatsApp, customers keep calling to ask where their load is, dispatchers lose time matching trucks, and drivers' papers and expenses arrive late.

provenance.quote: Data stays in India

history.value: At the branches in Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata and Ahmedabad, in the trucks on the road across India, and in customers' offices.

provenance.quote: the time a dispatcher spends assigning a load down from 25 minutes to under 10
Multiple languages

value: Customers and their admins, dispatchers, branch managers, drivers, fleet maintenance, finance, compliance, the operations head and the group administrator.

flows.name: Register and Book
flows.goal: Register a customer company and submit a freight booking.
alternates: If phone verification fails, allow the user to retry rather than continuing unauthenticated.
If company registration or booking submission cannot be completed, retain entered values for correction and show the problem.
acceptance: A customer user can sign in with a phone code and register a customer company with its GST number.
The registered customer can submit a booking with pickup and drop addresses, material, weight and requested date.
The submitted booking appears in that customer's own booking list and can be opened for details.

provenance.quote: request a quote

flows.name: Request a Quote
flows.goal: Request freight pricing for a prospective load.
alternates: If required load details are missing, identify them for correction before submission.
If submission fails, keep the entered request available to retry.
acceptance: A customer admin signs in using a phone code and can enter prospective load details in a quote request.
The request is saved against that admin's own company and is available for later review.

flows.name: Track a Booking
flows.goal: Follow a booking through trip location, status, and delivery proof.

steps.action: choose one of your tracked bookings
view the trip’s latest map location

alternates: If location data is not available, show the latest available trip status and indicate that a live location is unavailable.
If no trip is associated yet, explain that tracking is not available for that booking yet.
If delivery proof has not been uploaded, show that no proof is available yet.
acceptance: A customer can select only a booking belonging to their own customer account.
For a booking with an associated trip, the customer can see the latest available location and trip status.
The customer can open available proof of delivery for the booking without seeing another customer’s trip information.

flows.name: Pay Freight Invoice
flows.goal: Review and pay an invoice for a customer booking.
acceptance: Review and pay an invoice for a customer booking. works from the first step to the last.

provenance.quote: raise a claim for damage or delay, see past bookings

flows.name: Raise a Claim
flows.goal: Raise a damage or delay claim and review past bookings.
alternates: If no eligible booking is available, explain that a booking must be selected before a claim can be raised.
If claim submission fails, preserve the entered details for retry.
acceptance: A customer can see past bookings belonging only to their own company.
The customer can submit a claim for damage or delay tied to one of those bookings.
The submitted claim appears in the customer's claims list.

flows.name: Assign a Load
flows.goal: Select an open booking and assign an available truck and driver.
acceptance: Select an open booking and assign an available truck and driver. works from the first step to the last.

flows.name: Coordinate a Trip
flows.goal: Monitor availability, handle a trip issue, and coordinate a reassignment or driver communication.
acceptance: Monitor availability, handle a trip issue, and coordinate a reassignment or driver communication. works from the first step to the last.

flows.name: Complete a Delivery
flows.goal: Accept a trip, update its status, and upload delivery proof.
acceptance: Accept a trip, update its status, and upload delivery proof. works from the first step to the last.

flows.name: Record Trip Costs
flows.goal: Record trip expenses, request an advance, and report a breakdown or accident.
alternates: If the trip is unavailable, let the driver return to their trip list and try again. If submission fails, preserve entered details for retry; a pending advance or expense remains visibly pending until reviewed or settled.
acceptance: The driver can record fuel, toll, or other trip-related expenses against their own trip.
The driver can request an advance and see its current status.
The driver can report a breakdown or accident, and can view their own earnings and settlement information when available.

flows.name: Maintain a Truck
flows.goal: Review a truck record and plan maintenance work.
acceptance: Review a truck record and plan maintenance work. works from the first step to the last.

flows.name: Complete Workshop Work
flows.goal: Review and complete workshop job card work.
acceptance: Review and complete workshop job card work. works from the first step to the last.

provenance.quote: reconcile payments, manage driver advances and settlements, export to Tally, see receivables ageing

flows.name: Reconcile and Settle
flows.goal: Reconcile customer payments and manage driver advances and settlements.
acceptance: Reconcile customer payments and manage driver advances and settlements. works from the first step to the last.

flows.name: Review Compliance
flows.goal: Review driver and vehicle records for validity and compliance.
acceptance: Review driver and vehicle records for validity and compliance. works from the first step to the last.

flows.name: Review Branch Performance
flows.goal: Review trip, utilisation, on-time delivery, and revenue dashboards across branches.
alternates: If no measures are available for the selected scope, show an empty state and allow the scope to be changed.
If a measure cannot be loaded, identify it as unavailable without presenting it as zero.
acceptance: The operations head can view cross-branch trip, utilisation, on-time delivery and revenue-per-truck measures.
The dashboard can be scoped to a selected date range and branch selection, and a branch can be opened for further detail.

flows.name: Manage Organisation
flows.goal: Manage branches, users, roles, approval limits, and audit records.
acceptance: Manage branches, users, roles, approval limits, and audit records. works from the first step to the last.

brief.summary: TruckSetu is a freight booking, dispatch and fleet administration app for customers and logistics teams in India.
brief.pitch: TruckSetu helps customers book and track freight loads while dispatchers assign trucks and drivers. Drivers update trips and upload delivery proof, and fleet, finance and compliance teams manage their work. Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are included in the freight charge; the app is not billed separately.

idea.summary: TruckSetu is a freight booking, dispatch and fleet administration app for customers and logistics teams in India.
idea.pitch: TruckSetu helps customers book and track freight loads while dispatchers assign trucks and drivers. Drivers update trips and upload delivery proof, and fleet, finance and compliance teams manage their work. Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are included in the freight charge; the app is not billed separately.
idea.subcategory: load booking, dispatch, trip tracking, and fleet administration
idea.business_model: Booking, tracking, invoices and online payment are all included in the freight charge; nothing is billed separately for the app.

domain_facts.statement: TruckSetu is a freight and fleet company.
TruckSetu is in Pune.
TruckSetu has branches in Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata and Ahmedabad.
They want one app and portal.
Customers book loads and track them.
Dispatchers assign trucks and drivers.
Drivers update trips and upload delivery proof.
The fleet team manages maintenance, fuel and permits.
The finance team manages invoices and payments.
The compliance team manages permits.
App or business name: TruckSetu
Your idea in one line: A freight and fleet app and portal for customers to book and track loads, staff to manage dispatch and trips, and teams to manage fleet and finance operations.
A customer (shipper) user is a platform role.
A customer admin is a platform role.
A dispatcher is a platform role.
A branch manager is a platform role.
A driver is a platform role.
A fleet maintenance manager is a platform role.
A workshop mechanic is a platform role.
A finance executive is a platform role.
A compliance officer is a platform role.
An operations head is a platform role.
A group administrator is a platform role.
Customers can register their company with a GST number and add users.
Customers can request a quote.
Customers can book a load with pickup and drop addresses, material, weight and date.
Customers can track a trip live on a map, see status updates and view delivery proof (POD).
Customers can download invoices and pay online.
Customers can raise a claim for damage or delay and see past bookings.
Dispatchers can see open bookings, assign trucks and drivers, and split or merge loads.
Dispatchers can see truck availability by branch, handle delays and breakdowns, reassign trips, and communicate with drivers.
Drivers can accept trips and navigate to pickup and drop.
Drivers can update trip status as reached, loaded, in transit or delivered.
Drivers can upload e-way bills, LR copies and POD photos.
Drivers can record fuel and toll expenses, request advances, see earnings and settlements, and report breakdowns or accidents.
Fleet maintenance can keep a truck register with RC, insurance, fitness, permit and PUC documents and expiry reminders.
Fleet maintenance can plan service schedules and raise workshop job cards.
Fleet maintenance can track spare parts and tyre life and see downtime.
Finance can create invoices with GST and e-invoicing and apply rate cards and surcharges.

Operations heads and group administrators can manage branches, users and roles, and approval limits for discounts and refunds.

Data stays in India.

domain_facts.statement: TruckSetu has 400 trucks.
TruckSetu has 600 drivers.
Customers book loads and track them.
Dispatchers assign trucks and drivers.
Drivers update trips and upload delivery proof.
The fleet team manages maintenance, fuel and permits.
The finance team manages invoices and payments.
The compliance team manages permits.
The app handles sensitive customer and driver data.
The app must follow Indian transport and GST rules.
Your idea in one line: A freight and fleet app and portal for customers to book and track loads, staff to manage dispatch and trips, and teams to manage fleet and finance operations.
A customer (shipper) user is a platform role.
A customer admin is a platform role.
A dispatcher is a platform role.
A branch manager is a platform role.
A driver is a platform role.
A fleet maintenance manager is a platform role.
A workshop mechanic is a platform role.
A finance executive is a platform role.
A compliance officer is a platform role.
An operations head is a platform role.
A group administrator is a platform role.
Customers can register their company with a GST number and add users.
Customers can request a quote.
Customers can book a load with pickup and drop addresses, material, weight and date.
Customers can track a trip live on a map, see status updates and view delivery proof (POD).
Customers can download invoices and pay online.
Customers can raise a claim for damage or delay and see past bookings.
Dispatchers can see open bookings, assign trucks and drivers, and split or merge loads.
Dispatchers can see truck availability by branch, handle delays and breakdowns, reassign trips, and communicate with drivers.
Drivers can accept trips and navigate to pickup and drop.
Drivers can update trip status as reached, loaded, in transit or delivered.
Drivers can upload e-way bills, LR copies and POD photos.
Drivers can record fuel and toll expenses, request advances, see earnings and settlements, and report breakdowns or accidents.
Fleet maintenance can keep a truck register with RC, insurance, fitness, permit and PUC documents and expiry reminders.
Fleet maintenance can plan service schedules and raise workshop job cards.
Fleet maintenance can track spare parts and tyre life and see downtime.
Finance can create invoices with GST and e-invoicing and apply rate cards and surcharges.
Finance can reconcile payments, manage driver advances and settlements, export to Tally and see receivables ageing.
Compliance can track driver licences and medical checks, permit and insurance validity, and e-way bill validity.
The platform must provide an audit trail of who changed what.
Operations heads and group administrators can view dashboards across branches for trips, utilisation, on-time delivery and revenue per truck.
Operations heads and group administrators can manage branches, users and roles, and approval limits for discounts and refunds.

The platform integrates with GPS telematics devices for live location, FASTag toll data, the e-way bill portal, GST e-invoice portal, a payment gateway for UPI and cards, SMS and WhatsApp notifications, and Tally accounting.
Customers can see only their own bookings.
Drivers can see only their own trips.
Finance can see invoices but not driver personal documents.
Every change to a rate or trip assignment must be logged.
Documents are kept for 8 years.
Data stays in India.
The app works in English, Hindi and Marathi.
Dispatchers assign our own and hired trucks and drivers.
Fleet, finance and compliance teams keep trucks and drivers legal, maintained and billed correctly.

Your idea in one line: It helps customers book and track freight loads, dispatchers assign our own and hired trucks and drivers, drivers record every trip with proof of delivery, and our fleet, finance and compliance teams keep trucks and drivers legal, maintained and billed correctly.
We start in Pune and Mumbai, then roll out to Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata and Ahmedabad.
Our teams and drivers use English, Hindi and Marathi.
Drivers need a mobile app.
Dispatchers need an app or portal.
Managers need a portal.
Finance and compliance teams need a portal.
Customers need a portal to book and track loads.
Fleet maintenance needs its own screens.

The dispatcher assigns a truck and driver.
The driver accepts the load.
The driver updates status and uploads the delivery proof.
The customer tracks the load and gets the invoice.
Finance collects payment and settles the driver.
They assign their own 400 trucks.
They assign hired trucks from independent owners in peak season.
The driver uploads the proof of delivery photo.
The dispatcher confirms the proof of delivery photo before the trip is closed.
Customers and drivers use phone codes to sign in.
Staff sign in through the company single sign-on with email.
A customer admin can add and remove users of their own company.
Customer booking and tracking is included in the first version.
Dispatch and driver trips are included in the first version.
Invoices and payments are included in the first version.
Fleet maintenance, compliance, and branch approvals can follow in the second version.
Faster load assignment
More on-time deliveries
Less time on admin
Better truck utilisation

The submitted booking appears in that customer's own booking list and can be opened for details.
